---
title: "国土数値情報 W07 流域メッシュ属性付与"
output: html_document
---

このRmdは、`13Tokyo_chronology_gsi_landform.csv` の `Lon` / `Lat` から100m地域メッシュコードを算出し、国土交通省・国土数値情報「流域メッシュ（W07、2009年度）」の属性を付与します。

W07は100m（3次メッシュ1/10細分）単位で整備され、1次メッシュごとに配布されています。そのため、地点をポリゴンに空間結合するのではなく、**地点座標から100mメッシュコードを計算し、W07の細分メッシュコードにキー結合**します。必要な1次メッシュのW07ファイルだけを取得します。

入力CSVと出力CSVは初期設定では同じファイルです。実行前のCSVはタイムスタンプ付きで自動バックアップします。

```{r w07_watershed_join, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# 0. USER SETTINGS
#    通常変更する場合はこのセクション
# ============================================================

# 地形分類付与済みCSV
INPUT_CSV <- "13Tokyo_chronology_gsi_landform.csv"

# W07列を追加して保存するCSV
# 初期値はINPUT_CSVと同一。既存ファイルは実行前にバックアップする。
OUTPUT_CSV <- "13Tokyo_chronology_gsi_landform.csv"

# 入力CSV内の列名
ID_COL  <- "JASID"
LON_COL <- "Lon"
LAT_COL <- "Lat"

# W07キャッシュ
W07_CACHE_DIR <- "W07_cache"
USE_CACHE <- TRUE
AUTO_DOWNLOAD <- TRUE

# 国土数値情報 W07
W07_YEAR <- 2009L
W07_DATASET_ID <- "W07"
W07_DATA_PAGE <- "https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/datalist/KsjTmplt-W07.html"

# 国土数値情報で一般に用いられているW07 GML ZIPの配置先。
# サーバ側仕様変更などで自動取得できない場合は、
# W07_DATA_PAGEから必要なZIPを手動取得してW07_CACHE_DIRへ置けばよい。
# W07の実データは dataset/year サブディレクトリに配置されている。
# 例:
# https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/data/W07/W07-09/W07-09_5338-jgd_GML.zip
W07_DOWNLOAD_BASE <- "https://nlftp.mlit.go.jp/ksj/gml/data/W07/W07-09"

# 10MB超のZIPもあるため、既定60秒では足りない環境に備える。
DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SEC <- 300

# 監査出力
W07_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT_CSV <- "W07_download_audit.csv"
W07_JOIN_SUMMARY_CSV <- "W07_join_summary.csv"

# 既にW07列がある場合は、再計算した値で置換する
REPLACE_EXISTING_W07_COLUMNS <- TRUE


# ============================================================
# 1. PACKAGE CHECK / DIRECTORIES
# ============================================================

required_packages <- c(
  "readr",
  "dplyr",
  "tibble",
  "sf"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(
    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "必要なRパッケージがありません: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "),
    "\n先に以下を実行してください:\n",
    "install.packages(c(",
    paste(sprintf('"%s"', missing_packages), collapse = ", "),
    "))"
  )
}

if (!file.exists(INPUT_CSV)) {
  stop("入力CSVが見つかりません: ", INPUT_CSV)
}

dir.create(
  W07_CACHE_DIR,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

cat("Input CSV : ", INPUT_CSV, "\n", sep = "")
cat("Output CSV: ", OUTPUT_CSV, "\n", sep = "")
cat("W07 cache : ", W07_CACHE_DIR, "\n\n", sep = "")


# ============================================================
# 2. READ INPUT
#    元CSVの文字列表現をできるだけ保持するため全列characterで読む
# ============================================================

input_data <- readr::read_csv(
  INPUT_CSV,
  col_types = readr::cols(
    .default = readr::col_character()
  ),
  locale = readr::locale(
    encoding = "UTF-8"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

required_input_cols <- c(
  LON_COL,
  LAT_COL
)

missing_input_cols <- setdiff(
  required_input_cols,
  names(input_data)
)

if (length(missing_input_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "入力CSVに必要な座標列がありません: ",
    paste(
      missing_input_cols,
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}

if (!ID_COL %in% names(input_data)) {
  warning(
    "ID_COL = '",
    ID_COL,
    "' が見つからないため、内部行番号を地点IDとして使用します。"
  )

  input_data[[ID_COL]] <- as.character(
    seq_len(nrow(input_data))
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 3. 100m STANDARD REGIONAL MESH CODE
#
# 1次メッシュ:
#   緯度側 = floor(lat * 1.5)
#   経度側 = floor(lon) - 100
#
# 2次: 1次メッシュを8×8
# 3次: 2次メッシュを10×10
# 1/10細分: 3次メッシュを10×10
#
# 出力:
#   10桁の100mメッシュコード
# ============================================================

lonlat_to_mesh100 <- function(
  lon,
  lat
) {
  lon <- as.numeric(lon)
  lat <- as.numeric(lat)

  valid <-
    is.finite(lon) &
    is.finite(lat) &
    lon >= 100 &
    lon < 180 &
    lat >= 0 &
    lat < 66.6666666667

  result <- rep(
    NA_character_,
    length(lon)
  )

  if (!any(valid)) {
    return(result)
  }

  x <- lon[valid]
  y <- lat[valid]

  # latitude
  lat_scaled <- y * 1.5
  p <- floor(lat_scaled)

  lat_rem1 <- (lat_scaled - p) * 8
  r <- floor(lat_rem1)

  lat_rem2 <- (lat_rem1 - r) * 10
  t <- floor(lat_rem2)

  lat_rem3 <- (lat_rem2 - t) * 10
  v <- floor(lat_rem3)

  # longitude
  lon_deg <- floor(x)
  q <- lon_deg - 100

  lon_rem1 <- (x - lon_deg) * 8
  s <- floor(lon_rem1)

  lon_rem2 <- (lon_rem1 - s) * 10
  u <- floor(lon_rem2)

  lon_rem3 <- (lon_rem2 - u) * 10
  w <- floor(lon_rem3)

  # floating-point roundoff対策
  r <- pmin(pmax(r, 0), 7)
  s <- pmin(pmax(s, 0), 7)
  t <- pmin(pmax(t, 0), 9)
  u <- pmin(pmax(u, 0), 9)
  v <- pmin(pmax(v, 0), 9)
  w <- pmin(pmax(w, 0), 9)

  result[valid] <- sprintf(
    "%02d%02d%d%d%d%d%d%d",
    as.integer(p),
    as.integer(q),
    as.integer(r),
    as.integer(s),
    as.integer(t),
    as.integer(u),
    as.integer(v),
    as.integer(w)
  )

  result
}


input_work <- input_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    .row_id = dplyr::row_number(),
    .place_id = as.character(
      .data[[ID_COL]]
    ),
    .lon = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        .data[[LON_COL]]
      )
    ),
    .lat = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(
        .data[[LAT_COL]]
      )
    ),
    .coordinate_valid =
      is.finite(.lon) &
      is.finite(.lat) &
      dplyr::between(
        .lon,
        -180,
        180
      ) &
      dplyr::between(
        .lat,
        -90,
        90
      ),
    watershed_mesh_code_100m =
      lonlat_to_mesh100(
        .lon,
        .lat
      ),
    watershed_first_mesh_code =
      dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(
          watershed_mesh_code_100m
        ),
        substr(
          watershed_mesh_code_100m,
          1,
          4
        ),
        NA_character_
      )
  )

needed_first_meshes <- input_work |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(
      watershed_first_mesh_code
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    watershed_first_mesh_code
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    watershed_first_mesh_code
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(
    watershed_first_mesh_code
  )

needed_mesh100 <- unique(
  stats::na.omit(
    input_work$watershed_mesh_code_100m
  )
)

cat(
  "Input rows             : ",
  nrow(input_work),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Valid coordinate rows  : ",
  sum(input_work$.coordinate_valid),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "100m mesh-coded rows   : ",
  sum(
    !is.na(
      input_work$watershed_mesh_code_100m
    )
  ),
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Required 1st meshes    : ",
  paste(
    needed_first_meshes,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


# ============================================================
# 4. W07 ZIP DOWNLOAD / EXTRACTION
# ============================================================

options(
  timeout = max(
    getOption("timeout"),
    DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SEC
  )
)


w07_filename <- function(
  first_mesh
) {
  sprintf(
    "W07-09_%s-jgd_GML.zip",
    first_mesh
  )
}


w07_download_url <- function(
  first_mesh
) {
  paste0(
    W07_DOWNLOAD_BASE,
    "/",
    w07_filename(
      first_mesh
    )
  )
}


prepare_w07_file <- function(
  first_mesh
) {
  zip_name <- w07_filename(
    first_mesh
  )

  zip_path <- file.path(
    W07_CACHE_DIR,
    zip_name
  )

  url <- w07_download_url(
    first_mesh
  )

  status <- "not_attempted"
  message_text <- NA_character_

  zip_ok <-
    file.exists(zip_path) &&
    isTRUE(
      file.info(zip_path)$size > 0
    )

  if (
    !zip_ok &&
    isTRUE(AUTO_DOWNLOAD)
  ) {
    cat(
      "Downloading W07 first mesh ",
      first_mesh,
      " ...\n",
      sep = ""
    )

    download_status <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(
        utils::download.file(
          url = url,
          destfile = zip_path,
          mode = "wb",
          method = "libcurl",
          quiet = FALSE
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message_text <<- conditionMessage(e)
        NA_integer_
      }
    )

    zip_ok <-
      isTRUE(
        download_status == 0L
      ) &&
      file.exists(zip_path) &&
      isTRUE(
        file.info(zip_path)$size > 0
      )

    status <- if (zip_ok) {
      "downloaded"
    } else {
      "download_failed"
    }
  } else if (zip_ok) {
    status <- "cached"
  }

  if (!zip_ok) {
    stop(
      "\nW07 ZIPを取得できませんでした。\n",
      "1次メッシュ: ",
      first_mesh,
      "\n期待するファイル名: ",
      zip_name,
      "\n自動取得URL: ",
      url,
      "\n\n国土数値情報の公式ページから手動取得し、\n",
      W07_CACHE_DIR,
      " に保存して再実行してください:\n",
      W07_DATA_PAGE,
      if (!is.na(message_text)) {
        paste0(
          "\nDownload message: ",
          message_text
        )
      } else {
        ""
      }
    )
  }

  extract_dir <- file.path(
    W07_CACHE_DIR,
    paste0(
      "W07_",
      first_mesh
    )
  )

  dir.create(
    extract_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  existing_files <- list.files(
    extract_dir,
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )

  spatial_candidates <- existing_files[
    grepl(
      "\\.(shp|gml|xml)$",
      existing_files,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    )
  ]

  if (
    length(spatial_candidates) == 0 ||
    !isTRUE(USE_CACHE)
  ) {
    utils::unzip(
      zip_path,
      exdir = extract_dir
    )

    existing_files <- list.files(
      extract_dir,
      recursive = TRUE,
      full.names = TRUE
    )

    spatial_candidates <- existing_files[
      grepl(
        "\\.(shp|gml|xml)$",
        existing_files,
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    ]
  }

  if (length(spatial_candidates) == 0) {
    stop(
      "ZIPを解凍しましたが、SHP/GML/XMLが見つかりません: ",
      zip_path
    )
  }

  list(
    first_mesh = first_mesh,
    zip_name = zip_name,
    zip_path = zip_path,
    url = url,
    download_status = status,
    extract_dir = extract_dir,
    candidate_files =
      spatial_candidates
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 5. W07 ATTRIBUTE FIELD DETECTION
#
# SHPでは公式属性名 W07_001 ... W07_006 を優先。
# GMLをGDAL経由で読む際の名称差にも候補名で対応する。
# ============================================================

normalize_name <- function(x) {
  tolower(
    gsub(
      "[^a-z0-9]",
      "",
      x
    )
  )
}


find_field <- function(
  nms,
  exact_candidates = character(),
  regex_candidates = character()
) {
  nms_norm <- normalize_name(nms)

  exact_norm <- normalize_name(
    exact_candidates
  )

  hit_exact <- match(
    exact_norm,
    nms_norm
  )

  hit_exact <- hit_exact[
    !is.na(hit_exact)
  ]

  if (length(hit_exact) > 0) {
    return(
      nms[
        hit_exact[1]
      ]
    )
  }

  for (
    pattern
    in regex_candidates
  ) {
    hit <- grep(
      pattern,
      nms_norm,
      perl = TRUE
    )

    if (length(hit) > 0) {
      return(
        nms[
          hit[1]
        ]
      )
    }
  }

  NA_character_
}


detect_w07_fields <- function(nms) {
  list(
    mesh_code = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_001",
        "meshCode",
        "mesh_code",
        "subdividedMeshCode",
        "subdivisionMeshCode"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "mesh.*code"
      )
    ),
    watersystem_code = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_002",
        "waterSystemCode",
        "watersystemcode",
        "riverSystemCode",
        "riversystemcode"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "(water|river).*system.*code"
      )
    ),
    river_code = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_003",
        "riverCode",
        "rivercode"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "^river.*code$"
      )
    ),
    watersystem_name = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_004",
        "waterSystemName",
        "watersystemname",
        "riverSystemName",
        "riversystemname"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "(water|river).*system.*name"
      )
    ),
    river_name = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_005",
        "riverName",
        "rivername"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "^river.*name$"
      )
    ),
    unit_basin_code = find_field(
      nms,
      exact_candidates = c(
        "W07_006",
        "unitBasinCode",
        "unitbasincode",
        "basinUnitCode",
        "basinunitcode"
      ),
      regex_candidates = c(
        "unit.*basin.*code",
        "basin.*unit.*code"
      )
    )
  )
}


integer_like_to_character <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, "integer64")) {
    return(
      as.character(x)
    )
  }

  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    out <- rep(
      NA_character_,
      length(x)
    )

    ok <- is.finite(x)

    out[ok] <- sprintf(
      "%.0f",
      x[ok]
    )

    return(out)
  }

  trimws(
    as.character(x)
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 6. READ ONE W07 FIRST-MESH FILE
#
# ZIP内に複数XML等がある場合があるため、
# sf::st_read()で読め、W07属性を検出できるファイルを選ぶ。
# ============================================================

read_one_w07_first_mesh <- function(
  prepared,
  needed_codes
) {
  candidate_files <- prepared$candidate_files

  # .shp を最優先、その後 .gml、.xml
  extension_rank <- dplyr::case_when(
    grepl(
      "\\.shp$",
      candidate_files,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ) ~ 1L,
    grepl(
      "\\.gml$",
      candidate_files,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ) ~ 2L,
    TRUE ~ 3L
  )

  candidate_files <- candidate_files[
    order(extension_rank)
  ]

  selected <- NULL
  selected_file <- NA_character_
  selected_fields <- NULL

  for (
    candidate
    in candidate_files
  ) {
    x <- tryCatch(
      suppressWarnings(
        sf::st_read(
          candidate,
          quiet = TRUE,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (
      is.null(x) ||
      nrow(x) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }

    field_map <- detect_w07_fields(
      names(x)
    )

    required_detected <- vapply(
      field_map,
      function(z) {
        !is.na(z)
      },
      logical(1)
    )

    if (all(required_detected)) {
      selected <- x
      selected_file <- candidate
      selected_fields <- field_map
      break
    }
  }

  if (is.null(selected)) {
    stop(
      "\nW07属性を読めるSHP/GML/XMLを検出できませんでした。\n",
      "1次メッシュ: ",
      prepared$first_mesh,
      "\n候補ファイル:\n",
      paste(
        candidate_files,
        collapse = "\n"
      ),
      "\n\n必要属性は W07_001 ～ W07_006 です。"
    )
  }

  attrs <- sf::st_drop_geometry(
    selected
  )

  out <- tibble::tibble(
    watershed_mesh_code_100m =
      integer_like_to_character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$mesh_code]]
      ),
    watersystem_code =
      integer_like_to_character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$watersystem_code]]
      ),
    river_code =
      integer_like_to_character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$river_code]]
      ),
    watersystem_name =
      as.character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$watersystem_name]]
      ),
    river_name =
      as.character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$river_name]]
      ),
    unit_basin_code =
      integer_like_to_character(
        attrs[[selected_fields$unit_basin_code]]
      ),
    w07_source_first_mesh =
      prepared$first_mesh,
    w07_source_file =
      basename(selected_file)
  ) |>
    dplyr::filter(
      watershed_mesh_code_100m %in%
        needed_codes
    ) |>
    dplyr::distinct(
      watershed_mesh_code_100m,
      .keep_all = TRUE
    )

  rm(
    selected,
    attrs
  )

  invisible(
    gc()
  )

  out
}


# ============================================================
# 7. DOWNLOAD / READ ONLY REQUIRED FIRST MESHES
# ============================================================

prepared_list <- lapply(
  needed_first_meshes,
  prepare_w07_file
)

download_audit <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    prepared_list,
    function(x) {
      tibble::tibble(
        first_mesh =
          x$first_mesh,
        zip_name =
          x$zip_name,
        zip_path =
          x$zip_path,
        url =
          x$url,
        download_status =
          x$download_status,
        n_candidate_files =
          length(
            x$candidate_files
          )
      )
    }
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  download_audit,
  W07_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT_CSV,
  na = ""
)

w07_lookup_list <- vector(
  "list",
  length(prepared_list)
)

for (
  i
  in seq_along(prepared_list)
) {
  first_mesh <-
    prepared_list[[i]]$first_mesh

  codes_this_mesh <-
    needed_mesh100[
      substr(
        needed_mesh100,
        1,
        4
      ) == first_mesh
    ]

  cat(
    "Reading W07 first mesh ",
    first_mesh,
    " (needed point meshes: ",
    length(codes_this_mesh),
    ") ...\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  w07_lookup_list[[i]] <-
    read_one_w07_first_mesh(
      prepared =
        prepared_list[[i]],
      needed_codes =
        codes_this_mesh
    )
}

w07_lookup <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  w07_lookup_list
) |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    watershed_mesh_code_100m,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

cat(
  "\nW07 records matched to needed 100m mesh codes: ",
  nrow(w07_lookup),
  "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)


# ============================================================
# 8. JOIN W07 ATTRIBUTES TO INPUT CSV
# ============================================================

w07_output_columns <- c(
  "watershed_mesh_code_100m",
  "watershed_first_mesh_code",
  "watersystem_code",
  "river_code",
  "watersystem_name",
  "river_name",
  "unit_basin_code",
  "w07_match_status",
  "w07_source_year",
  "w07_source_id",
  "w07_source_first_mesh",
  "w07_source_file"
)

base_for_join <- input_work

if (
  isTRUE(
    REPLACE_EXISTING_W07_COLUMNS
  )
) {
  base_for_join <- base_for_join |>
    dplyr::select(
      -dplyr::any_of(
        setdiff(
          w07_output_columns,
          c(
            "watershed_mesh_code_100m",
            "watershed_first_mesh_code"
          )
        )
      )
    )
}

output_data <- base_for_join |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    w07_lookup,
    by = "watershed_mesh_code_100m"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    w07_match_status =
      dplyr::case_when(
        !.coordinate_valid ~
          "invalid_coordinate",
        is.na(
          watershed_mesh_code_100m
        ) ~
          "mesh_code_unavailable",
        !is.na(
          watersystem_code
        ) |
        !is.na(
          watersystem_name
        ) |
        !is.na(
          unit_basin_code
        ) ~
          "matched",
        TRUE ~
          "no_w07_match"
      ),
    w07_source_year =
      W07_YEAR,
    w07_source_id =
      W07_DATASET_ID
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    -dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        ".row_id",
        ".place_id",
        ".lon",
        ".lat",
        ".coordinate_valid"
      )
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# 9. SAFE SAVE
#    OUTPUT_CSVがINPUT_CSVと同一でも安全に置換する
# ============================================================

timestamp <- format(
  Sys.time(),
  "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"
)

input_abs <- normalizePath(
  INPUT_CSV,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

output_abs <- normalizePath(
  dirname(OUTPUT_CSV),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

output_abs <- file.path(
  output_abs,
  basename(OUTPUT_CSV)
)

same_input_output <- identical(
  input_abs,
  output_abs
)

if (
  same_input_output
) {
  backup_file <- file.path(
    dirname(INPUT_CSV),
    paste0(
      tools::file_path_sans_ext(
        basename(INPUT_CSV)
      ),
      "_before_W07_",
      timestamp,
      ".csv"
    )
  )

  backup_ok <- file.copy(
    INPUT_CSV,
    backup_file,
    overwrite = FALSE
  )

  if (!backup_ok) {
    stop(
      "入力CSVのバックアップ作成に失敗しました: ",
      backup_file
    )
  }

  cat(
    "Backup created: ",
    backup_file,
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}

temp_output <- tempfile(
  pattern = "W07_join_",
  tmpdir = dirname(OUTPUT_CSV),
  fileext = ".csv"
)

readr::write_csv(
  output_data,
  temp_output,
  na = ""
)

copy_ok <- file.copy(
  temp_output,
  OUTPUT_CSV,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

unlink(
  temp_output
)

if (!copy_ok) {
  stop(
    "出力CSVの保存に失敗しました: ",
    OUTPUT_CSV
  )
}


# ============================================================
# 10. QA SUMMARY
# ============================================================

match_summary <- output_data |>
  dplyr::count(
    w07_match_status,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    proportion =
      n_rows /
      sum(n_rows)
  )

watersystem_summary <- output_data |>
  dplyr::filter(
    w07_match_status ==
      "matched"
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(
    watersystem_code,
    watersystem_name,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(
      n_rows
    )
  )

join_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(
    summary_type = "run",
    item = c(
      "input_rows",
      "valid_coordinate_rows",
      "required_first_mesh_count",
      "required_unique_100m_mesh_count",
      "matched_w07_unique_100m_mesh_count",
      "w07_year"
    ),
    value = as.character(
      c(
        nrow(input_work),
        sum(
          input_work$.coordinate_valid
        ),
        length(
          needed_first_meshes
        ),
        length(
          needed_mesh100
        ),
        nrow(
          w07_lookup
        ),
        W07_YEAR
      )
    )
  ),
  match_summary |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      summary_type =
        "match_status",
      item =
        w07_match_status,
      value =
        as.character(
          n_rows
        )
    ),
  watersystem_summary |>
    dplyr::transmute(
      summary_type =
        "watersystem",
      item =
        paste0(
          watersystem_code,
          ":",
          watersystem_name
        ),
      value =
        as.character(
          n_rows
        )
    )
)

readr::write_csv(
  join_summary,
  W07_JOIN_SUMMARY_CSV,
  na = ""
)


# ============================================================
# 11. FINAL REPORT
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\n============================================================\n",
  "W07 watershed join completed\n",
  "============================================================\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "Output CSV             : ",
  OUTPUT_CSV,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "W07 download audit     : ",
  W07_DOWNLOAD_AUDIT_CSV,
  "\n",
  sep = ""
)

cat(
  "W07 join summary       : ",
  W07_JOIN_SUMMARY_CSV,
  "\n\n",
  sep = ""
)

print(
  match_summary
)

cat(
  "\nWatersystem summary:\n"
)

print(
  watersystem_summary
)
```
